privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: $t(app.name) is built to keep your usage data on your Mac. We do not operate servers that collect your provider credentials or usage history.
privacy.contact: Questions? Reach the author on GitHub:

sections.title: Summary
sections.body: $t(app.name) does not require an account with us. We do not sell your data. We do not use analytics, advertising networks, crash reporting SDKs, or third-party trackers in the app or on this website.

sections.title: Data stored on your Mac
sections.body: Provider credentials are stored in the macOS Keychain. Usage history, preferences, and widget snapshots are stored locally on your Mac. This data never leaves your device except when the app calls provider APIs you configure.

sections.title: This website
sections.body: This landing page does not use cookies, analytics, or embedded third-party widgets. We do not collect personal information when you browse token-bar.pages.dev.

sections.title: Third parties
sections.body: GitHub release downloads and GitHub links on this site send you to GitHub. Provider connectors call the APIs you configure (Cursor, OpenAI, Anthropic, or your proxy). We do not integrate any other third-party services.

sections.title: Open source
sections.body: $t(app.name) is open source. You can review the application code on GitHub to verify how data is handled.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: If this policy changes, we will update this page. Continued use of the app or website after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: Install $t(app.name), connect providers, and customize how usage appears in your menu bar.
installSteps: Download the latest DMG from GitHub Releases.
Open the disk image and drag TokenBar to Applications.
Launch TokenBar—it lives in the menu bar with no Dock icon.
quickStartSteps: Click the menu bar icon and open Settings.
Connect a provider under Providers (e.g. Cursor Personal or Demo Provider).
Pick a display mode under General.
Use Refresh Now or enable automatic refresh.
